review_evidence: README describes Evariste as theorem-proving research software, but the source also contains an independently useful Lean theorem corpus.
lean_imo_th/imo_th.lean contains named proved inequalities and olympiad-style results, including Cauchy-Schwarz and AM-QM/GM-AM families.
Because genuine mathematical statements and proofs coexist with proof-search tooling, source-level retirement would lose reusable prior art.
summary: Reviewed Evariste; retain the source because its theorem-prover tooling is accompanied by a genuine Lean mathematical theorem corpus.
